name: @qa-portal/module-governance
description: Governance module (Sign-off/Approvals/Admin/Reports) -- its own Module Federation remote, independently built/deployed/versioned from the shell and the other 3 modules. Exposes ./SignOff, ./Approvals, ./Admin, ./Reports for the shell to load at runtime; can also run standalone via `npm run dev`/`npm run preview` for isolated development.
